style.medium: Polished storybook game illustration, soft chalky gouache fills with restrained fine texture, clean silhouettes, thin warm charcoal contours; no glossy plastic or pixel art
style.view: Elevated three quarter props on 2:1 isometric ground. Circular avatar portraits always screen-facing
style.light: Soft ambient daylight, mild upper-left highlights; no baked floor or cast shadows
style.character: Blank circular ivory portrait disc, teal canvas jacket, ochre short overalls, cream mitten hands and cocoa ankle boots. Match NEW reference identity exactly

camper-idle.action: subtle breathing, arms relaxed, feet planted, blank face

camper-walk.action: walking in place toward screen right three-quarter view, alternating left/right foot contacts and opposite arms, full cycle, blank face

camper-run.action: running in place toward screen right three-quarter view, alternating feet, wider stride and bent swinging arms, full cycle

camper-sit.action: seated resting pose on invisible log, feet forward, arms resting beside belly, small breathing change

camper-crouch.action: low crouch, knees bent, body lowered, feet firmly planted

camper-jump.action: jump poses: preparation crouch, rising with arms lifted, airborne descending arms out, landing crouch; no vertical root translation

camper-carry.action: holding an invisible friend overhead with BOTH mitten hands high above head, slight weight shift, feet planted

camper-carried.action: being held aloft with dangling legs and arms extended sideways, gentle sway

camper-wave.action: wave with right hand raised beside head, alternate hand angle, return near start

camper-heart.action: both mitten hands together in front of chest forming a loving gesture, gentle pulse, no detached hearts

camper-clap.action: hands open at chest, hands meet clapping, hands open, hands meet, feet planted

camper-dance.action: joyful side-to-side dance alternating raised hands and lifted feet

camper-laugh.action: laughing body gesture with hands over belly, alternating hunch and upright, blank face

camper-surprise.action: surprised gesture, hands up beside head, straighten then settle, blank face

camper-weapon.action: holding invisible toy at waist toward screen right with both hands: aim, small recoil, recover, aim. No actual weapon drawn

camper-hit.action: startled recoil backward, small squash, return to standing; blank face, no injuries
